title: Jephthah and Ephraim

questions.question: Why were the men of Ephraim angry with Jephthah?
options: Because he did not call them to go with him to fight Ammon
questions.correctAnswer: Because he did not call them to go with him to fight Ammon
questions.explanation: Judges 12:1 (ESV): "...they said to Jephthah, 'Why did you cross over to fight against the Ammonites and did not call us to go with you?'"

questions.question: What word did the Gileadites use to identify Ephraimites?
questions.explanation: Judges 12:6 (ESV): "...they said to him, 'Then say Shibboleth'..."

questions.question: How many Ephraimites fell at that time?
questions.explanation: Judges 12:6 (ESV): "...and there fell at that time 42,000 of the Ephraimites."

questions.question: How long did Jephthah judge Israel?
Who judged Israel after Jephthah?
questions.explanation: Judges 12:8 (ESV): "After him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel."

questions.question: What threat did Ephraim make against Jephthah's house?
options: We will burn your house over you with fire
questions.correctAnswer: We will burn your house over you with fire
questions.explanation: Judges 12:1 (ESV): "...We will burn your house over you with fire."

questions.question: How did the Ephraimites pronounce "Shibboleth"?
questions.explanation: Judges 12:6 (ESV): "...and he said, 'Sibboleth,' for he could not pronounce it right."

questions.question: Who judged Israel after Ibzan?
questions.explanation: Judges 12:11 (ESV): "After him Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel..."

questions.question: Who judged Israel after Elon?
questions.explanation: Judges 12:13 (ESV): "After him Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel."

questions.question: What unique detail is given about simple Abdon's family?
options: He had 40 sons and 30 grandsons, who rode on 70 donkeys
questions.correctAnswer: He had 40 sons and 30 grandsons, who rode on 70 donkeys
questions.explanation: Judges 12:14 (ESV): "He had 40 sons and 30 grandsons, who rode on 70 donkeys..."

questions.question: Where was Jephthah buried?
questions.explanation: Judges 12:7 (ESV): "...and was buried in his city in Gilead."

questions.question: How long did Abdon judge?
questions.explanation: Judges 12:14 (ESV): "...and he judged Israel eight years."

questions.question: What reason did Jephthah give Ephraim for fighting without them?
options: I and my people had a great dispute with the Ammonites... and when I called you, you did not save me
questions.correctAnswer: I and my people had a great dispute with the Ammonites... and when I called you, you did not save me
questions.explanation: Judges 12:2 (ESV): "...I and my people had a great dispute with the Ammonites, and when I called you, you did not save me..."

key_verse_text: they said to him, “Then say Shibboleth,” and he said, “Sibboleth,” for he could not pronounce it right. Then they seized him and slaughtered him... (ESV)
